_about: SYNTHETIC document fixtures for tier T1 (design section 9). Every excerpt and body is invented to carry the figures recorded in labels.json; none is a real filing and none is point-in-time true. They test the document-driven rules and the validator. They are never used to claim live accuracy. Each case is classified on the cohort evening of its ex-date (as_of = ex_date) with the documents captured at 10:00Z that day.

documents.title: Yahoo corporate actions for TRENT.NS
documents.note: Shape written by quant.triage.sources.actions_result. Yahoo lists the 1.5 split on 2026-06-04, five months after the jump. That listing did not exist on 2026-01-01, so this is not point-in-time true. The rules look only five days either side of the jump, so the engine still abstains: a known miss.
